description: You can follow the given error snapshot through a simulated chain of function calls.

steps.description: InterpreterError stores a message and list of function names. Its formatter displays that list in reverse order.
The entry and exit helpers update call_stack. raise_error copies the current list into the exception.
main, foo, bar, and baz enter their names before calling inward. Their finally blocks remove those names while the exception unwinds.

steps.answer: No. The exception holds a separate list copied when the error was raised.
steps.question: Will unwinding the live stack erase the exception's saved names?

steps.description: The recording prints the undefined-x error followed by baz, bar, foo, and main. That order places the innermost call first.

title: Read the supplied call-stack recorder
